    GObjectRegistry
    Defines the main registry for checking for GObjects, primarily used by these subsystems: CommandParser/TaggedArgUtil /Command/TypingHints for command parsing, usage parsing, typed hints and etc PropertiesUI for showing properties of these objects And overall just decentralisation of making these objects.
